cornerstone.full_quote: Each of the Cornerstone Investors has agreed that it will not, whether directly or indirectly, at any time during the period commencing from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date (the “Lock-up Period”) dispose of any of the Offer Shares it has subscribed for or any interest in any company or entity holding any of such Offer Shares pursuant to the relevant Cornerstone Investment Agreements, save for in certain limited circumstances, such as transfers to any of its wholly owned subsidiaries or wholly controlled entities who will be bound by the same obligations of such Cornerstone Investor, including the Lock-up Period restriction.
cornerstone.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date; document wording 'commencing from (and inclusive of) the Listing Date and ending on (and inclusive of) the date falling six (6) months after the Listing Date' - restricted period inclusive of Listing Date

controller_6m.full_quote: (a) in the period commencing on the date of the prospectus and ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date (the “First Six-Month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares or securities of the Company in respect of which it/he/she is shown in the prospectus to be the beneficial owners; or
controller_6m.basis: six calendar months from the Listing Date ('ending on the date which is six months from the Listing Date'); document anchors commencement to 'the date of the prospectus' (inclusive of Listing Date)
controller_6m.notes: Introduced by 'In accordance with Rule 10.07(1) of the Listing Rules, each of the Controlling Shareholders has undertaken to us and the Stock Exchange that...'.

controller_12m.full_quote: (b) in the period of six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-month Period expires (the “Second Six-Month Period”), dispose of, nor enter into any agreement to dispose of, or otherwise create any options, rights, interests or encumbrances in respect of, any of the Shares or securities referred to in (a) above if, immediately following such disposal or upon the exercise or enforcement of such options, rights, interests or encumbrances, it/he/she would cease to be a controlling shareholder of our Company.
controller_12m.basis: Rule 10.07(1)(b) second six-month period: 'six months commencing on the date on which the First Six-month Period expires', i.e. 12 calendar months from the Listing Date; applies to disposals that would cause the holder to cease to be a controlling shareholder
